description: Hooks for the confighub-ai plugin. Every hook is inert unless PILOT_ACTIVE is exactly 1 or the person using the session typed /confighub-pilot:on, so an installed plugin does not inspect, block, emit into, or create state for unrelated Claude sessions. The session switch hook runs first on UserPromptSubmit and acts only on the exact /confighub-pilot:on, :off and :status prompts; on PreToolUse Bash it refuses commands that name the switch directory while Pilot is active. SessionStart reads fast local context and shows a compact Pilot hello. The PreToolUse Bash group binds the default-deny Scout command-shape gate, Cub flag/exact-revision validation, the non-blocking retired --web warning, the authenticated-approval gate including the digest-pinned standalone cub-* add-on perimeter, Bash activity tracing, and skill attribution. A separate PreToolUse Skill group records model-selected Skill loads. Canonical Scout MCP tool names have their own default-deny matcher; these command-shape gates are defense in depth, not an OS/process sandbox, and never confer authoritative/T2/T3 proof. PostToolUse governed-write enforcement injects corrective context when proof is incomplete. UserPromptSubmit restores the branded response contract and injects deterministic URL/journey routing. Stop appends the turn's measured token-usage delta to the activity trace silently and, when something ran this turn, draws a small Pilot cockpit card under the reply; SessionEnd flushes the final usage delta and runs the advisory harvest discipline audits, silent when clean.
